title: add recursive search to load_dot_env
description: Added functionality to recursively search parent directories for an .env file.  Users can opt-in to this by setting recursive = TRUE.  If recursive = TRUE, then load_dot_env will search the directory, and if no .env file is found, parent directories are searched until one is found.
